content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. On 31 July 2026, the Union Cabinet approved continuation of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme from 2026-27 through 2030-31. The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare said the approved financial outlay was Rs. 3.15 lakh crore.

The release describes PM-KISAN as direct income support for eligible landholding farmer families. It says eligible families receive Rs. 6,000 annually in three equal instalments through direct benefit transfer. This is a paraphrased fixture; the cited PIB page is the authoritative source.
title: Cabinet approves continuation of the PM-KISAN Scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a Financial Outlay of Rs.3.15 lakh crore
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. On 17 August 2026, the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology said 31 additional proposals had been approved under the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme, with projected investment of Rs. 6,844 crore.

The release reported 106 approved ECMS projects, projected investment of Rs. 69,548 crore, and around 75 thousand direct jobs. It also said 38 plants were operational and 16 were in advanced construction. This summary is a local fixture and does not replace the linked release.
title: ECMS Accelerates Electronics Manufacturing: 38 Plants Operational, 16 in Advanced Construction Stages
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release concerning Union Budget 2026-27. The Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology said the budget announced India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, covering equipment and materials, Indian intellectual property, supply chains, research, and training.

The release states that Rs. 1,000 crore was provided for the initiative in FY 2026-27 and that the Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme outlay would increase to Rs. 40,000 crore. This concise record is prepared for RAG testing; consult the linked release for full context.
title: Budget 2026-27 announces the launch of India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare said the Prime Minister would release the 22nd PM-KISAN instalment from Guwahati, Assam, on 13 March 2026. The release stated more than Rs. 18,640 crore would be transferred to more than 9.32 crore farmer families through DBT.

It also said the cumulative amount transferred would exceed Rs. 4.27 lakh crore and more than 2.15 crore women would receive benefits in that instalment. This record paraphrases the source for a development corpus and does not replace the official publication.
title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi to Release 22nd Instalment of PM-KISAN on 13th March
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare reported that agriculture ministers from 22 states attended the National Kharif Conference at the PUSA campus in New Delhi on 28 and 29 May 2026.

The release describes the conference as a coordination forum for agricultural reforms and mentions soil health, environmental sustainability, nutrition security, farmer prosperity, and implementation. This local summary preserves dates, organisations, and numerical details for testing while retaining the official PIB citation.
title: 22 State Agriculture Ministers Come Together in a Historic First for Indian Agriculture
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. In a 24 March 2026 release, the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare stated that PM-KISAN had disbursed more than Rs. 4.27 lakh crore in 22 instalments since the scheme began.

The release describes PM-KISAN as a central-sector scheme launched in February 2019. It says eligible cultivable landholding farmer families receive Rs. 6,000 yearly in three equal instalments through Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts and DBT. The cited PIB page remains the source of record.
title: PM-Kisan: Centre disburses Rs. 4.27 lakh crore in 22 installments since inception
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. On 3 February 2026, the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare said the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare budget allocation rose from Rs. 21,933.50 crore in 2013-14 to Rs. 1,27,290.16 crore in 2025-26.

The source says agriculture is a state subject and describes central support through policy measures, budget allocations, and schemes. It lists PM-KISAN, PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana, PM-AASHA, and crop-insurance schemes. This is an attribution-preserving local development summary.
title: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Budget Jumps from Rs. 21,933 Crore to Rs. 1.27 Lakh Crore in 12 Years
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

content:
Local development summary of an official PIB release. The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare announced that the Prime Minister would release the 23rd PM-KISAN instalment from Tarakeswar in Hooghly district, West Bengal, on 20 June 2026.

The release said more than Rs. 18,880 crore would be transferred to over 9.44 crore farmers, including over 2.18 crore women farmers. It also described connections through Krishi Vigyan Kendras, ICAR institutes, universities, farmer organisations, markets, and local-government functions. Use the PIB URL for authoritative evidence.
title: Prime Minister to Release the 23rd Instalment of PM-KISAN from Tarakeswar, Hooghly, West Bengal on 20th June 2026
publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
author: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
